facts.claim: Nijjar shot 18 June 2023 outside Guru Nanak Sikh Gurdwara, Surrey, sitting in his truck; he was its president
Trudeau alleged 'potential link' to agents of Government of India on 18 Sept 2023
facts.note: narration says 'exactly four months later'; it was 3 months

facts.claim: India called the allegations 'absurd and motivated'
Nijjar group: SFJ / India says KTF chief
facts.note: narration: 'head of Sikhs for Justice Federation' not confirmed; say 'linked to SFJ; India called him KTF chief'

facts.claim: 14 Oct 2024 RCMP: Bishnoi gang connected to agents of Govt of India; both countries expelled six diplomats incl. high commissioners
facts.note: narration places 'US prosecutors' in 2024: in 2024 it was Canadian police (RCMP)

facts.claim: July 2026 US federal indictment (Los Angeles) charges Bishnoi and Goldy Brar with ordering Nijjar killing; run from Indian jail via smuggled phones; Operation Hardball, 24 arrests; FBI $50,000 reward for Brar; indictment does NOT allege Indian govt role
facts.note: narration at 143s says US report puts 'all these killings' on Bishnoi: not supported; indictment is about Nijjar, not Pakistan killings

facts.claim: Zahoor Mistry (Zahoor Ibrahim), IC-814 hijacker, shot dead Karachi March 2022
Paramjit Singh Panjwar, KCF chief, shot dead by unidentified gunmen in Lahore, May 2023
Bashir Ahmad Peer, Hizbul commander, shot dead in Rawalpindi Feb 2023
Bishnoi ABP News jail interview March 2023; says opposed to Khalistan
facts.note: narration says interview of Bishnoi AND Goldy Brar; found only Bishnoi

facts.claim: 1998 blackbuck case during Hum Saath Saath Hain shoot near Jodhpur; Bishnoi community protects blackbuck
14 Apr 2024 two men on a bike fired outside Galaxy Apartments; Anmol Bishnoi claimed
facts.note: rounds reported as 3, 4 or 5: don't show a number

facts.claim: Baba Siddique shot dead Oct 2024; Facebook post by Bishnoi associate claimed it, citing ties to Salman Khan and Dawood; police checking
facts.note: narration says Goldy Brar gang; reports say Bishnoi gang

facts.claim: Salman Khan had close connection with Dawood Ibrahim in the 90s
facts.note: no source; do not show; defamation risk

facts.claim: 2018 Jodhpur court sentenced Salman Khan to five years in blackbuck case; later granted bail, appeal pending

facts.note: screen shows only '2022 · Threat letter'; 'to Salim Khan' not confirmed

facts.claim: March 2023 threat email; FIR names Bishnoi, Goldy Brar, Rohit Garg
July 2026: Canada says no proof India was behind Nijjar killing
facts.note: page could not be captured; shown as timeline event 'Canada: proof nahi'

facts.claim: Goldy Brar on FBI Ten Most Wanted (added 28 Sept 2026)
